page_description: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi. Digest is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Miniflux project.
release_notes: Renamed from RSS Reader - Miniflux to Digest, so the app carries its own name rather than the name of the server it talks to.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Miniflux instance, either self-hosted or hosted, and create an API token.
Install the token under the exact name miniflux; the runtime sends it as X-Auth-Token.
